title: Koszul presentation and unit for constant or completed coefficients
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subset A$ an ideal. Use the constant sheaf $\underline A$, the completed sheaf $B=\lim_n\underline{A/I^{n+1}}$, and their standard module, complex and derived categories [def-sfb-constant-completion-coefficient-data]. For $b\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ let $\mathcal O_b$ be respectively $\underline A$ or $B$, with its canonical map from $\underline A$ [def-pur-strict-quotient-completion-data]. For $r\geq0$ and $a:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$, let $a_i^{\mathcal O_b}$ be the image of $a_i$ under this map, using the constant-sheaf sheafification unit. Define $\operatorname{KoszulPresentation}(J,A,I,b,r,a)$ to be the existing strict derived Koszul-limit presentation for $\mathcal O_b$ and these global sections [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system], with the standard derived localizations for modules and strict module towers. Thus its tensor tower is the strict tower of tensors with the dual Koszul complexes, and its inverse-limit functor has its universal right-derived comparison. For such a presentation $K$, define $\operatorname{koszulCompletion}(J,A,I,K)=K.\operatorname{completion}$ and $\operatorname{koszulUnit}(J,A,I,K,M)=K.\operatorname{unit}(M)$ for every $M\in D(\mathcal O_b)$. The unit uses the actual degree-zero Koszul augmentation and the presentation's derived-limit comparison. These are presentation data and their projections; no equivalence, completeness, Noetherian hypothesis or reflector theorem is asserted.
